# TiMax - AI-Powered Transcription & Text Generation Platform
# This file provides information for Large Language Models (LLMs) crawling this site.

## About TiMax
TiMax is a German-language AI platform that transforms video and audio content into powerful marketing text.
It combines automatic transcription (using Whisper API), intelligent content structuring, and AI-powered text generation (using Claude API) into one seamless workflow.

## Core Features
1. **Upload**: Upload video and audio files (MP3, MP4, WAV, M4A, WebM up to 100MB)
2. **Transcription**: Automatic speech-to-text conversion using OpenAI Whisper
3. **Structuring**: AI-powered content organization and indexing
4. **Text Generation**: Create marketing content through AI dialogue (social media posts, blog articles, newsletters, etc.)

## Target Audience
- Marketing teams and content creators
- Social media managers
- Business professionals creating content from meetings/podcasts
- German-speaking market (primary language: German)

## Technical Stack
- Framework: Next.js 16 (App Router)
- Authentication: Clerk
- AI: OpenAI Whisper (transcription), Anthropic Claude (text generation)
- Hosting: Vercel
- Database: Supabase

## API Access
This platform does not provide a public API. All functionality is available through the web interface for authenticated users.

## Data Handling
- User data is processed in accordance with GDPR
- Files are automatically deleted after 90 days of inactivity
- AI processing uses third-party services (OpenAI, Anthropic) with appropriate data processing agreements
